title: Join the First Business Central Hackathon at DynamicsCon 2026
summary: The first Business Central Hackathon is being hosted at DynamicsCon 2026 on May 13th as an evening creative sprint where teams build AI-related solutions. The event welcomes developers of all skill levels, low-code creators, and professionals to collaborate, experiment, and learn through hands-on building in a social, low-pressure environment focused on Business Central and AI.
key_points: Hackathon themed around 'Business Central AI' with wide scope: AI inside BC, AI feeding BC, or AI around BC using any tool or technology
Open to pro developers, low-code creators in Power Platform or Copilot Studio, AI enthusiasts, and professional coaches regardless of experience level
Five-hour evening event May 13th 8:00pm-1:00am with team formation, mentorship, lightning demos, midpoint check-ins, and final presentations
Emphasizes learning and collaboration over competition; no prior expertise required, just curiosity and willingness to experiment with a team

quotes.text: A Hackathon is basically a creative sprint where people come together to build something new in a short burst of focused energy.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines what a hackathon is for those unfamiliar with the format, establishing expectations for the event.

quotes.text: I wanted a social event that brought my fellow nerds together and gave us a challenge to do as a group.
quotes.why_it_matters: Reveals the organizer's motivation to create a technical, community-focused event for developers and tech enthusiasts at the conference.
